name: Yo-Yo Ma

name: Bernard Hinault
milestone: Won the Tour de France in July 1978 at age 23, also winning the Vuelta a España that same year, establishing himself as the dominant cyclist of his era. By 26 he had also won the 1979 Tour de France and the 1980 Giro d'Italia.

name: Olga Korbut
milestone: Won three gold medals (team, balance beam, floor exercise) and one silver (uneven bars) at the 1972 Munich Olympics at age 17, revolutionizing gymnastics with her acrobatic style and innovative moves.

name: Paolo Maldini

name: Grigori Perelman

name: Ayrton Senna

name: Nadia Comăneci

name: Carla Bruni

She signed with City Models at 19 in 1987 and rose rapidly through the Guess? campaign and major runway shows.

name: Madonna

name: Mats Wilander

name: Karl-Heinz Rummenigge

milestone: Won the 1991 British Formula Three Championship at age 19 as the youngest champion in the category's history, after winning the Formula Opel Lotus Euroseries in 1990 at age 18, and made his Formula One debut with Jordan in 1993 at age 21.

name: Paolo Rossi
milestone: Became the first player to top the scoring charts in Serie B (21 goals, 1976-77) and Serie A (24 goals, 1977-78) in consecutive seasons at age 21-22, and won the Silver Ball as second-best player at the 1978 FIFA World Cup while becoming the world's most expensive player.

name: Miki Matsubara
milestone: Released her debut single 'Mayonaka no Door (Stay With Me)' on November 5, 1979 at age 19, which became a commercial hit reaching No. 28 on the Oricon Singles Chart and establishing her as a next-gen city pop artist with Pony Canyon.

name: Bjorn Borg
milestone: Won his first French Open title at age 18 in June 1974, the youngest male French Open champion at the time, having already made Sweden's Davis Cup team at 15, won the Wimbledon junior title and Orange Bowl at 16, and turned professional at 16 in 1973.

name: Agnetha Faltskog
milestone: Her self-penned debut single 'Jag var sa kar' ('I Was So in Love') topped the Swedish chart on January 28, 1968 at age 17, selling over 80,000 copies and knocking The Beatles from the number one spot, leading to her self-titled debut album later that year.

name: Salvatore Garau
milestone: Became the drummer of the Italian progressive rock group Stormy Six in 1977 at age 23-24, performing on the critically noted album 'L'Apprendista' (1977), which was well received in progressive rock circles and released on the L'Orchestra label.

name: Stefan Edberg
milestone: Won his first Grand Slam singles title at the 1985 Australian Open at age 19, defeating defending champion Mats Wilander in straight sets, after achieving the junior Grand Slam in 1983.

name: Michael Jackson
milestone: Released 'Thriller' in November 1982 at age 24, which became the best-selling album of all time. Earlier milestones include four consecutive No. 1 Billboard Hot 100 singles with the Jackson 5 starting in 1969 at age 11, and the breakthrough solo album 'Off the Wall' in 1979 at age 21.

name: Riccardo Patrese
milestone: Made Formula One debut at the 1977 Monaco Grand Prix at age 23, having won both the Italian and European Formula 3 championships in 1976 and the Karting World Championship in 1974 at age 20.

name: Goran Bregović
milestone: Released debut album with Bijelo Dugme in November 1974 at age 24, which broke the Yugoslav record for best-selling rock album and earned a gold record by February 1975.

name: Lilian Thuram
milestone: Made professional debut with Monaco in Ligue 1 on May 24, 1991 at age 19, won the Coupe de France that season, and by age 26 was a 1998 FIFA World Cup winner with France awarded the Bronze Ball as third best player.

name: Paul Breitner
milestone: Debuted for Bayern Munich's senior team in 1970 at age 19, won the 1972 European Championship at 21, the 1974 FIFA World Cup at 22 (scoring in the final), and the 1974 European Cup, all before age 26.

name: Roger Milla
milestone: Signed for top-division club Léopard Douala in 1970 at age 18 and won three Cameroonian championship titles, scoring 89 goals in 116 appearances over four years. Made Cameroon national team debut in 1973 and was African Footballer of the Year in 1976 at age 24.

name: Jean Alesi
milestone: Won the French Formula Three Championship in 1987 at age 23, won the International Formula 3000 Championship in 1989 at age 25, debuted in Formula One at the 1989 French Grand Prix finishing fourth, and scored maiden F1 podiums at the opening round and Monaco in 1990 at age 25-26.

name: Tom Hanks
milestone: Landed co-lead role in the ABC television sitcom Bosom Buddies in 1980 at age 24, which ran for two seasons and launched his career. Also made film debut in He Knows You're Alone (1980) and won the Cleveland Critics Circle Award for Best Actor in 1978 at age 21.

name: John Deacon
milestone: Released Queen's self-titled debut album in 1973 at age 22 and wrote the international hit 'You're My Best Friend' for A Night at the Opera in 1975 at age 24.

name: Oleg Blokhin
milestone: Won the Ballon d'Or as European Footballer of the Year in December 1975 at age 23, having already become the Soviet Top League's standout striker for Dynamo Kyiv and led the team to the UEFA Cup Winners' Cup.

name: Cameron Diaz
milestone: Made her film debut at 21 as the female lead in The Mask (1994), which became one of the top 10 highest-grossing films of the year and launched her as a Hollywood star.

name: Eric Cantona
milestone: Won the 1988 U21 European Championship with France at age 22, scoring a hat-trick in the quarter-final against England, and transferred to Marseille for a French record fee shortly after.

name: Whitney Houston
milestone: Released her self-titled debut album Whitney Houston on February 14, 1985 at age 21, which became the best-selling debut album by a solo artist in history, topping the Billboard 200 for 14 weeks and generating three #1 singles.

name: Xabi Alonso
milestone: Captained Real Sociedad to a 2nd-place finish in La Liga in the 2002-03 season at age 21, winning the Best Spanish Player award, and made his debut for the Spain national team in April 2003.

name: Ralf Schumacher
milestone: Won the Formula Nippon championship in 1996 at age 21 as the first rookie ever to clinch the title, and entered Formula One with Jordan in 1997 at age 22.

name: Kim Kyong-il
milestone: Selected to North Korea's 23-man squad for the 2010 FIFA World Cup at age 22, and represented North Korea at the 2005 FIFA U-17 World Championship and 2007 FIFA U-20 World Cup.

name: Tom Cruise
milestone: Breakthrough leading role in 'Risky Business' (1983) at age 21, which grossed $65 million and earned him a Golden Globe nomination; cemented superstar status with 'Top Gun' (1986) at age 24.

name: Gabriel Batistuta
milestone: Won the Copa América 1991 with Argentina at age 22, finishing as tournament top scorer with 6 goals, and earned a transfer to Fiorentina in Serie A the same summer.

name: Kim Myong-gil
milestone: Named to North Korea's 23-man squad for the 2010 FIFA World Cup at age 25, the country's first World Cup appearance since 1966, having represented the national team in World Cup qualifiers from 2005.

name: Teofilo Stevenson
milestone: Won Olympic gold medal in heavyweight boxing at the 1972 Munich Olympics at age 20, followed by World Championship gold in 1974 and a second Olympic gold at the 1976 Montreal Olympics at age 24.

name: Rowan Atkinson
milestone: First won national attention at the Edinburgh Festival Fringe in August 1976 at age 21 with the Oxford Revue, leading to a BBC Radio 3 series and the landmark BBC2 sketch show Not the Nine O'Clock News in October 1979 at age 24, for which he won a BAFTA in 1981.

name: Kate Bush
milestone: Topped the UK singles chart for four weeks in March 1978 at age 19 with her debut single 'Wuthering Heights,' becoming the first female artist to achieve a UK number one with a fully self-written song; her debut album The Kick Inside sold over a million copies.

name: Mark Webber
milestone: Made his Formula One debut at the 2002 Australian Grand Prix on March 3, 2002 at age 25, finishing fifth and scoring points — becoming the 51st driver in F1 history to score on debut and the first Australian F1 driver since 1994.

name: Gianluigi Buffon
milestone: Made his Serie A debut for Parma on November 19, 1995 at age 17, keeping a clean sheet against reigning champions AC Milan, and by 26 had become a World Cup-winning goalkeeper, Serie A champion, and the world's most expensive goalkeeper transfer.

name: George Weah
milestone: Signed for AS Monaco in 1988 at age 22 after being discovered by Arsène Wenger, was named African Footballer of the Year in 1989 at age 23, won the Coupe de France with Monaco in 1991, and helped Monaco reach the European Cup Winners' Cup final in 1992 before signing for PSG at age 26.

name: Klaus Ebner
milestone: Won the Großer Österreichischer Jugendpreis (Austrian Youth Prize for Literature) in 1982 at age 18 for the novella 'Das Brandmal,' and again in 1988 for the novel 'Nils,' establishing early recognition as a literary talent.

name: Peter Jackson
milestone: Received funding from the New Zealand Film Commission in 1986 (age 24-25) to complete his first feature film Bad Taste, which premiered at the 1988 Cannes Film Festival when he was 26, launching his professional filmmaking career.

name: Gheorghe Hagi
milestone: Made his Divizia A (Romanian top division) debut at age 17 in 1982-83 for FC Constanța, then scored 58 goals in 108 appearances for Sportul Studențesc between 1983 and 1986 (ages 18-21), becoming one of Romania's most prodigious young talents and drawing the attention of dictator Ceaușescu before transferring to Steaua București in 1986.

name: Michele Alboreto
milestone: Won the European Formula Three Championship in 1980 (age 23-24), made his Formula One debut with Tyrrell at the 1981 San Marino Grand Prix (age 24), and won his first F1 Grand Prix at the 1982 Caesars Palace Grand Prix in Las Vegas (age 25), establishing himself as a rising star in motorsport.

name: Mo Yan
milestone: Published his first short story in a literary journal in 1981 at age 26, marking the beginning of his professional writing career while serving in the People's Liberation Army.

name: Ben Affleck
milestone: Co-wrote and starred in Good Will Hunting (1997) with Matt Damon, winning the Academy Award for Best Original Screenplay in March 1998 at age 25, which launched him to mainstream fame.

name: Elio de Angelis
milestone: Won the Italian Formula Three Championship in 1977 at age 19, made his Formula One debut with Shadow at the 1979 Argentine Grand Prix at age 20, and won his first F1 Grand Prix (1982 Austrian GP) at age 24, establishing himself as a top-tier racing driver by his mid-twenties.

name: Xavi
milestone: Made his first-team debut for FC Barcelona in August 1998 at age 18, scored on his official debut, and won the 1998-99 La Liga title at age 19, being named La Liga Breakthrough Player of the Year.

name: Marita Koch
milestone: Set her first outdoor world record in the 400 metres in July 1978 at age 21, won two gold medals at the 1978 European Championships in Prague, and became the first woman to run 200 metres under 22 seconds in 1979 at age 22. By age 26 she had set multiple world records and won the 1983 World Championship 200m title.

name: Franco Baresi
milestone: Made his Serie A debut for AC Milan on April 23, 1978 at age 17, won the 1978-79 Serie A title in his first full season at 18, and was named club captain at age 22, becoming one of the youngest captains in Milan's history.

name: Jean-Claude Van Damme
milestone: Won the European Karate Championship as a member of the Belgian Karate Team on 26 December 1979 at age 19, and won the Mr. Belgium bodybuilding title in 1978 at age 17-18. Both are material competitive achievements before age 26, though his acting breakthrough came later with Bloodsport (1988) at age 28.

name: Linda Evangelista
milestone: Signed with Elite Model Management and had her first major fashion magazine cover (L'Officiel, November 1984) at age 19. By age 26 (1991), she was one of the most famous supermodels in the world, featured on the cover of British Vogue (January 1990) and in George Michael's 'Freedom! '90' video.

name: John Lydon
milestone: Became lead vocalist of the Sex Pistols in 1975 at age 19. The band released 'Anarchy in the U.K.' (November 1976), 'God Save the Queen' (May 1977), and the album 'Never Mind the Bollocks, Here's the Sex Pistols' (28 October 1977) at age 21. He then founded Public Image Ltd in 1978 at age 22, releasing their debut album in 1978.

name: Zlatan Ibrahimović
milestone: Joined Ajax in July 2001 at age 19-20 and won the 2001-02 Eredivisie title. By age 26 (October 2007), he had also played for Juventus (2004-2006) and Inter Milan (2006-2007), won multiple league titles, been named Serie A Foreign Footballer of the Year (2005), and won the Guldbollen (Swedish player of the year) in 2005.

name: Michèle Mouton
milestone: Crowned French and European ladies' rally champion in 1974 at age 23, then won the two-litre prototype class at the 24 Hours of Le Mans in 1975 at age 24, and was signed by Fiat France for 1977 finishing runner-up in the European Rally Championship at age 25-26.

name: Kimi Räikkönen
milestone: Made Formula One debut with Sauber in 2001 at age 21, achieved maiden podium on debut with McLaren in 2002, won first Grand Prix at Malaysia in 2003 at age 23, and won seven Grands Prix finishing runner-up to Fernando Alonso in the 2005 championship at age 26.

name: Johnny Depp
milestone: Became a teen idol starring as Officer Tom Hanson in the Fox television series '21 Jump Street', which premiered in 1987 when Depp was 24; had already made his feature film debut in 'A Nightmare on Elm Street' (1984) at age 21 and appeared in 'Platoon' (1986).

name: Sia
milestone: Her debut solo single 'Taken for Granted' peaked at #10 on the UK Singles Chart in June 2000 at age 24, also topping the UK R&B Chart; her second studio album 'Healing Is Difficult' was released in 2001 at age 25, establishing her as a recording artist in the UK market.

name: Didier Pironi
milestone: Won the Formula Renault Eurocup in 1974 at age 22, then won the 24 Hours of Le Mans in 1978 at age 26 and made his Formula One debut the same year.

name: Mariah Carey
milestone: Released her debut album 'Mariah Carey' in June 1990 at age 21, which reached #1 on the Billboard 200 and produced four #1 singles; won Grammy Awards for Best New Artist and Best Female Pop Vocal Performance in 1991.

name: Richard Clayderman
milestone: Recorded 'Ballade pour Adeline' in 1976 at age 23, which became a massive international hit selling millions of copies and launching a career that has sold over 120 million records worldwide.

name: Pak Sung-hyok
milestone: Selected for the North Korea 2010 FIFA World Cup squad at age 20, having debuted for the national team in 2009 at age 19.

name: Pak Chol-jin
milestone: Debuted for the North Korea national football team in 2003 at age 18, played in multiple World Cup qualifying campaigns, and was selected for the 2010 FIFA World Cup squad at age 25.

name: George Michael
milestone: Wham!'s debut album 'Fantastic' reached #1 on the UK Albums Chart in July 1983 when Michael was 20, following hit singles 'Young Guns (Go for It)' and 'Wham Rap!'

name: Phil Collins
milestone: Joined Genesis as drummer in August 1970 at age 19, recording multiple albums including 'Nursery Cryme' (1971), 'Foxtrot' (1972), and 'Selling England by the Pound' (1973), and became lead vocalist in 1975 at age 24.

name: Wladimir Klitschko
milestone: Won Olympic gold medal in super-heavyweight boxing at the 1996 Atlanta Olympics at age 20, and won the WBO heavyweight championship in 2000 at age 24.

name: Hristo Stoichkov
milestone: Won the European Golden Shoe as top scorer in European leagues with 38 goals for CSKA Sofia in 1990 at age 24, then joined Barcelona and won the 1992 European Cup at age 26.

name: Aki Kaurismäki
milestone: Directed his debut feature film Crime and Punishment (1983), an adaptation of Dostoevsky set in modern Helsinki, at age 26, having co-founded the production company Villealfa Filmproductions with his brother Mika.

name: Sinéad O'Connor
milestone: Released debut album The Lion and the Cobra in October 1987 at age 20, achieving international chart success and a Grammy nomination, followed by the seven-million-selling I Do Not Want What I Haven't Got in 1990 at age 23.

name: David Hasselhoff
milestone: Landed a regular leading role as Dr. Snapper Foster on the CBS soap opera The Young and the Restless in December 1975, which he held for six years.

name: Rivaldo
milestone: Signed for FC Barcelona in 1997 at age 25 as a 17 million pound replacement for Ronaldo, going on to win consecutive La Liga titles in 1998 and 1999.

name: Uli Hoeneß
milestone: Won three consecutive Bundesliga titles (1972-1974), three consecutive European Cups (1974-1976), the 1972 European Championship, and the 1974 FIFA World Cup with West Germany, all by age 24; scored twice in the 1974 European Cup final replay.

name: Francesco Totti
milestone: Became the youngest club captain in Serie A history at age 22 in October 1998, and was named Serie A Young Footballer of the Year for the 1998-99 season, having made his Serie A debut at 16 in March 1993.

name: Ari Vatanen
milestone: Won the British Rally Championship in 1976 at age 24 driving a Ford Escort RS1800, and competed in the World Rally Championship from 1974.

name: Ole Einar Bjørndalen
milestone: Won the Overall Biathlon World Cup title in 1997-98 at age 24, Olympic gold in the 10km sprint at the 1998 Nagano Olympics, and a World Championship gold medal — achieving all three major biathlon titles in one season.

name: Valentino Rossi
milestone: Won the 125cc World Championship in 1997 at age 18, dominating with 11 of 15 race wins, and followed with the 250cc World Championship in 1999 at age 20 and the 500cc World Championship in 2001 at age 22.

name: Oliver Kahn
milestone: Transferred to Bayern Munich in 1994 at age 25 for a record goalkeeper fee of DM 4.6 million, becoming the club's starting goalkeeper, after establishing himself at Karlsruher SC and reaching the 1993-94 UEFA Cup semi-finals.

name: Robert Downey Jr.
milestone: Cast as a regular on Saturday Night Live for the 1985-86 season at age 20; starred in multiple Brat Pack films including Weird Science (1985), Back to School (1986), Less Than Zero (1987), and The Pick-Up Artist (1987) — by age 26 had appeared in over 15 films.

name: Luis Suárez
milestone: Won the Eredivisie title and KNVB Cup with Ajax (2009-10 season) at age 22-23; won the 2011 Copa América with Uruguay at age 24; scored 111 goals in 159 appearances for Ajax before transferring to Liverpool in 2011.

name: Avicii
milestone: Released the single 'Levels' in 2011 at age 22, which became a global hit certified platinum in multiple countries and launched him to international stardom; his debut album True (2013) reached the top 10 in over 15 countries.

name: Will Smith
milestone: Won the first-ever Grammy Award for Best Rap Performance in 1989 at age 20 for 'Parents Just Don't Understand' with DJ Jazzy Jeff, and launched The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air TV series in 1990 at age 22.

name: Nicolas Cage
milestone: Starred in leading roles in multiple major films by age 26, including Valley Girl (1983), Raising Arizona (1987), Moonstruck (1987), and Vampire's Kiss (1989).

name: Filippo Inzaghi
milestone: Won the Capocannoniere (Serie A top scorer) with 24 goals for Atalanta in the 1996-97 season at age 23, and was named Serie A Young Footballer of the Year, before transferring to Juventus and winning the Scudetto.

name: Shakira
milestone: Released breakthrough album Pies Descalzos (1995) at age 18, which sold over 5 million copies and established her across Latin America; followed by Dónde Están los Ladrones? (1998) and Laundry Service (2001) which sold 13M+ copies, making her a global superstar by age 24.

name: Mikhail Khodorkovsky
milestone: Founded Bank Menatep in 1989 at age 26, one of the first privately owned commercial banks in Russia, after establishing a successful import-export business and the Youth Centre for Scientific and Technical Development in 1987 at age 24.

name: Mario Kempes
milestone: Won the 1978 FIFA World Cup with Argentina at age 24, finishing as the tournament's top scorer (6 goals) and best player (Golden Ball), after becoming top scorer in the Argentine championship at age 20 and La Liga top scorer at age 22-23.

name: Raúl
milestone: Debuted for Real Madrid's first team at age 17 in October 1994, won La Liga that season, and by age 26 had won three Champions League titles (1998, 2000, 2002), six La Liga titles, and become one of the world's greatest strikers.

name: David Beckham
milestone: Won the FA Youth Cup with Manchester United's Class of '92 in May 1992 and made his first-team debut on 23 September 1992 at age 17, launching a career that by age 26 included six Premier League titles, two FA Cups, and the 1999 UEFA Champions League.

name: Hans Zimmer
milestone: Composed his first film score for 'Moonlighting' (1982), a Palme d'Or-nominated Channel 4 film, at age 24-25, and co-founded Lillie Yard Studio with film composer Stanley Myers that same year.

name: Jacques Villeneuve
milestone: Won the Indianapolis 500 and the IndyCar World Series championship in 1995 at age 24, becoming the youngest IndyCar champion and first Canadian Indy 500 winner; then won the Formula One World Drivers' Championship in 1997 at age 26.

name: John McEnroe
milestone: Won his first U.S. Open singles title in 1979 at age 20, becoming the youngest U.S. champion in 31 years; reached Wimbledon semifinals at 18 in 1977 as a qualifier, won the NCAA singles title in 1978, and won four Grand Slam singles titles and reached world No. 1 by age 26.

name: Gerhard Berger
milestone: Made Formula One debut at the 1984 Austrian Grand Prix at age 24 driving for ATS, and secured a full-season F1 drive with Arrows in 1985, establishing himself as an F1 driver by age 26.

name: Monica Seles
milestone: Won the 1990 French Open at age 16, becoming the youngest-ever French Open champion, and reached world No. 1 ranking in March 1991 at age 17. By age 26 she had won 9 Grand Slam singles titles.

name: Sebastian Vettel
milestone: Won the 2008 Italian Grand Prix at age 21, becoming the youngest-ever F1 race winner at the time, and became the youngest-ever Formula One World Champion in 2010 at age 23. By age 26 he had won three consecutive World Championships.

name: Sade
milestone: Released debut album 'Diamond Life' on July 16, 1984 at age 25, which became one of the best-selling debut albums of the 1980s, selling over 10 million copies worldwide and winning the 1985 Brit Award for Best British Album.

name: Mohammed Ben Sulayem
milestone: Won his first FIA Middle East Rally Championship title in 1986 at age 24, becoming the UAE's first motor-racing champion. By age 26 he had won two consecutive MERC titles (1986 and 1987).

name: Rudi Völler
milestone: Became Bundesliga top scorer with 23 goals for Werder Bremen in the 1982-83 season at age 23, was named German Footballer of the Year in 1983, and earned his first cap for West Germany in 1982.

name: Cha Bum-kun
milestone: Became the youngest player in the world to reach 100 international caps at age 24 in 1978, won Asian Games gold medal in 1978, and signed with Eintracht Frankfurt in the Bundesliga in July 1979 at age 26, later winning the UEFA Cup in 1980.

name: Mike Oldfield
milestone: Released debut album 'Tubular Bells' on 25 May 1973 at age 20, which became the first release on Virgin Records, sold over 2.7 million copies in the UK, reached No. 1 on the UK album chart, and was used in the film The Exorcist.

name: Bonnie Tyler
milestone: Her debut single 'Lost in France' reached #9 on the UK singles chart in 1976 at age 25, and her debut album 'The World Starts Tonight' was released in February 1977, both before her 26th birthday in June 1977.

name: Adrian Smith
milestone: Joined Iron Maiden in November 1980 at age 23 and recorded on 'The Number of the Beast' (1982), which reached #1 on the UK albums chart and became one of the most influential heavy metal albums of all time, all before turning 26 in February 1983.

name: Eros Ramazzotti
milestone: Won the Sanremo Music Festival main competition in 1986 at age 22 with 'Adesso tu,' having already won the Newcomers' category in 1984 and released a debut album with multi-million-selling singles across Europe by 1985.

name: Pavel Nedvěd
milestone: Was a key player in Czech Republic's run to the Euro 1996 final at age 23-24, scoring against Italy, and transferred to Serie A club Lazio in 1996 after winning three league titles with Sparta Prague.

name: The Undertaker
milestone: Won the WWF Championship at Survivor Series on November 27, 1991 at age 26, defeating Hulk Hogan to become the youngest WWF Champion in history at that point.

name: Val Kilmer
milestone: Received top billing in his film debut 'Top Secret!' (1984) at age 24, followed by lead role in 'Real Genius' (1985) and the iconic Iceman role in 'Top Gun' (1986), which grossed over $344 million worldwide.

name: Dunga
milestone: Captained Brazil's U-20 team to victory at the 1983 FIFA U-20 World Cup at age 19, won Olympic silver at the 1984 Los Angeles Games at age 20, and won the 1989 Copa América with Brazil at age 26.

name: Enrique Iglesias
milestone: Released debut album 'Enrique Iglesias' on November 21, 1995 at age 20, selling one million copies in three months with five number-one singles on Billboard's Hot Latin Songs chart, and won the Grammy Award for Best Latin Pop Performance in February 1997 at age 21.

name: Jean-Marie Pfaff
milestone: Won the Belgian Golden Shoe as player of the year in 1978 at age 24, won the Belgian Cup with Beveren in 1978, and won the Belgian national championship with Beveren in 1979 at age 25, while also being Belgium's starting goalkeeper from 1976.

name: Peter Schmeichel
milestone: Won Danish league titles with Brøndby in 1987, 1988, and 1990, the Danish Cup in 1989, and was named Danish Goalkeeper of the Year (Det Gyldne Bur) multiple times by age 26, establishing himself as Denmark's top goalkeeper before his move to Manchester United.

name: Luka Modrić
milestone: Won six domestic trophies with Dinamo Zagreb, was named Player of the Year in the Bosnian league on loan at age 18, and earned a £16.5m transfer to Tottenham Hotspur in 2008 at age 23, becoming a Croatia international since 2006.

name: Fabio Cannavaro
milestone: Made his Serie A debut for Napoli in 1993 at age 19, then won the UEFA Cup and Coppa Italia with Parma by 1999 (age 25-26), and became an Italy international in 1997, all well before age 26.

name: John Travolta
milestone: Became a teen idol starring as Vinnie Barbarino in Welcome Back, Kotter (1975) at age 21, then achieved international stardom with Saturday Night Fever (1977) at age 23, earning an Academy Award nomination for Best Actor.

name: Richard Branson
milestone: Founded Virgin Records label in 1973 at age 23 and released Mike Oldfield's Tubular Bells, a major commercial success that established Virgin as a significant music brand.

name: Adam D'Angelo
milestone: Became Chief Technology Officer of Facebook in 2006 at age 22, then co-founded Quora in June 2009 at age 24, both before age 26.

name: Aaron Swartz
milestone: Co-authored the RSS 1.0 specification at age 14 in 2000, became co-owner of Reddit through the Infogami merger in 2005 at age 19, and Reddit was acquired by Conde Nast in 2006 for approximately $5 million at age 20, all well before age 26.

name: Max Rafael Levchin
milestone: Co-founded Fieldlink (later Confinity, then PayPal) with Peter Thiel in 1998 at age 23, serving as CTO and building the anti-fraud systems including one of the first commercial CAPTCHAs; PayPal went public in February 2002 at age 26 and was acquired by eBay later that year.

name: Justin Frankel
milestone: Created and publicly released Winamp, the dominant MP3 player software, at age 19 in 1997; by 1998 it had over 15 million downloads and he founded Nullsoft to distribute it.

name: John Collison
milestone: Co-founded Stripe in 2010 at age 20 with his brother Patrick; Stripe received backing from Elon Musk, Peter Thiel, Max Levchin, and Sequoia Capital, and Collison became the world's youngest self-made billionaire by 2016 at age 25-26.

name: Guillermo Rauch
milestone: Created and publicly released Socket.IO in 2010 at approximately age 23-24, an influential open-source real-time communication library that became one of the most widely used web frameworks, powering products at Microsoft Office, Yammer, Zendesk, and the first Coinbase trading platform. He also co-founded LearnBoost in 2010, one of the earliest production adopters of Node.js.

name: Russel Simmons
milestone: Co-founded Yelp in October 2004 at approximately age 25-26 with Jeremy Stoppelman, serving as CTO from July 2004 to June 2010. Yelp became a major public internet company (IPO 2012) and one of the leading user-generated review platforms. Prior to Yelp, Simmons was a co-founder and Lead Software Architect at PayPal.

name: Evan You
milestone: Released Vue.js, a lightweight JavaScript frontend framework, publicly on GitHub and Hacker News in February 2014 at age 26, attracting immediate community adoption and growing into one of the top three frontend frameworks globally.

name: Dan Abramov
milestone: Released Redux, a JavaScript state management library, in June 2015 at age 22, which quickly became the dominant state management solution in the React ecosystem with billions of npm downloads.

name: Bram Cohen
milestone: Released the first BitTorrent client and protocol implementation on July 2, 2001 at age 25, creating what would become one of the most widely used peer-to-peer file-sharing protocols, accounting for 43-70% of all internet traffic by 2009.

name: Patrick Collison
milestone: Co-founded Stripe (originally /dev/payments), a payment infrastructure company, with his brother John in 2010 at age 22, which grew into a company valued at tens of billions of dollars; previously co-founded and sold Auctomatic for $5 million in 2008 at age 19.

name: Sam Yagan
milestone: Co-founded SparkNotes, an online study guide company, during his senior year at Harvard in 1999 at age 22, and sold it for $30 million in 2000; later co-founded eDonkey (2002) and OkCupid (2003), all before age 26.

name: Jawed Karim
milestone: Co-founded YouTube in February 2005 at age 25, the world's largest video-sharing platform, which was acquired by Google in 2006 for $1.65 billion.

name: Andrew McCollum
milestone: Co-founded Facebook in February 2004 at age 20, one of the most consequential social media companies in history, alongside Mark Zuckerberg, Dustin Moskovitz, and Chris Hughes.

name: Steve Chen
milestone: Co-founded YouTube in February 2005 at age 26, the world's largest video-sharing platform, and served as its CTO. YouTube was acquired by Google in 2006 for $1.65 billion.

name: Jeremy Stoppelman
milestone: Co-founded Yelp in summer 2004 at age 26, building it into a major local-search and review platform that went public in 2012 with a market capitalization of approximately $4 billion.

name: Paul Allen
milestone: Co-founded Microsoft with Bill Gates in 1975 at age 22 and co-developed Altair BASIC, the first product of the company that would pioneer the personal computer revolution.

name: Chris Hughes
milestone: Co-founded Facebook in 2004 at age 20, serving as spokesman and early product/UX contributor during its initial growth from Harvard to a multi-school platform.

name: Janus Friis
milestone: Co-founded KaZaA in 2000-2001 at age 24, which became the world's most popular peer-to-peer file-sharing application after Napster's shutdown, with hundreds of millions of downloads globally by age 25-26.

name: John Romero
milestone: Co-founded id Software on February 1, 1991 at age 23, shipped the seminal Commander Keen series (December 1990), Wolfenstein 3D (May 1992), and Doom (December 1993) by age 26, games that defined and popularized the first-person shooter genre.

name: Beyoncé
milestone: Destiny's Child debut album released February 1998 at age 16, going platinum with Top 3 hit 'No, No, No Part 2'; solo debut 'Dangerously in Love' (2003, age 22) won 5 Grammys; 'B'Day' released September 2006 at age 25.

name: Teresa Teng
milestone: Began her professional singing career in 1967 (age 14) with her first album release, TV hosting role, and record contract. By 1968 (age 15), she achieved widespread fame in Taiwan through 'The Gathering of Stars' TV program. By age 26 (1979), she was a dominant pop star across Asia with multiple hit albums, concerts in Southeast Asia, and recordings in multiple languages.

name: Gianna Nannini
milestone: Released her self-titled debut album in 1976 (age 22) and her second album 'Una Radura' in 1977. Her first domestic hit single 'America' and the album 'California' came in 1979 (age 25), making her a recognized figure in the Italian rock scene by age 26.

name: Davor Šuker
milestone: Won the 1987 FIFA U-20 World Cup with Yugoslavia at age 19 (scoring 6 goals in 6 matches), and by 25-26 was among the top scorers in La Liga with 24 goals in the 1993-94 season for Sevilla.

name: Keanu Reeves
milestone: Achieved his first major commercial success with Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventure (1989) at age 25, following critically acclaimed roles in River's Edge (1986) and Dangerous Liaisons (1988).

name: Allan Simonsen
milestone: Won the 1977 Ballon d'Or (European Footballer of the Year) at age 24, the only Danish player ever to receive the award; earlier won the 1971 and 1972 Danish championships with Vejle BK and scored 3 goals at the 1972 Summer Olympics before transferring to Borussia Mönchengladbach.

name: Hernán Crespo
milestone: Made his professional debut with River Plate in November 1993 at age 18, scoring 13 goals in 25 league appearances and winning the 1993 Apertura title; later won the 1996 Copa Libertadores at age 21, scoring twice in the final against América de Cali.

name: Agnetha Fältskog
milestone: Her self-penned debut single 'Jag var så kär' ('I Was So in Love') topped the Swedish sales chart on 28 January 1968 at age 17, selling over 80,000 copies and reaching #3 on Svensktoppen; her self-titled debut album followed in spring 1968, establishing her as one of Sweden's most popular pop artists.

name: Peter Gabriel
milestone: Co-founded Genesis at Charterhouse School in 1967 (age 17), released debut album From Genesis to Revelation in 1969 (age 19), and by age 26 had released multiple progressive rock classics including Nursery Cryme (1971), Foxtrot (1972), and Selling England by the Pound (1973).

name: Sid Vicious
milestone: Was the bassist for the Sex Pistols during the release of 'Never Mind the Bollocks, Here's the Sex Pistols' (October 1977), one of the most influential punk rock albums ever recorded.

name: Morrissey
milestone: The Smiths' debut album reached #2 on the UK Albums Chart in February 1984 when Morrissey was 24, following the top-25 UK single 'This Charming Man' in October 1983.

name: Tony Adams
milestone: Won the Football League Cup with Arsenal in 1987 at age 20 and became Arsenal's youngest-ever captain at age 21 in January 1988, establishing himself as a first-team regular and England international by his early twenties.

name: Cafu
milestone: Won back-to-back Copa Libertadores (1992, 1993) and Intercontinental Cup (1992, 1993) with São Paulo FC, and was named South American Footballer of the Year in 1994, all by age 24.

name: A. R. Rahman
milestone: Composed the debut film score for Mani Ratnam's Roja (released July 1992) at age 25, winning the National Film Award for Best Music Direction.

name: Angus Young
milestone: By age 19, Young co-founded AC/DC and released their debut album High Voltage (1975) which reached #7 in Australia; by 25, Back in Black (1980) became one of the best-selling albums of all time.

name: Andriy Shevchenko
milestone: At age 18, Shevchenko debuted for Dynamo Kyiv's first team (November 1994), scored in the UEFA Champions League against Bayern Munich, and went on to win five consecutive league titles and score a Champions League hat-trick against Barcelona at Camp Nou before age 23.

name: Didier Deschamps
milestone: Won the 1993 UEFA Champions League with Marseille as the youngest captain ever to lift the trophy, and won two Ligue 1 titles (1990, 1992), all before age 26.

name: Alessandro Del Piero
milestone: Made professional debut in Serie B at age 17 (March 1992) and signed for Juventus at 18 (1993), going on to win multiple Serie A titles and the UEFA Champions League (1996) by age 26.

name: Roberto Mancini
milestone: Debuted in Serie A at 16 for Bologna in September 1981, was transferred to Sampdoria for £2.2 million at 17, and by 26 had won the Cup Winners' Cup (1990) and multiple Coppa Italia titles while earning 36 caps for Italy.

name: Neymar
milestone: Made professional debut at 17 in March 2009, won the Copa do Brasil at 18 (2010) as top scorer, won the Copa Libertadores at 19 (2011) as Best Player, and was voted South American Footballer of the Year in 2011 and 2012, all well before 26.

name: Amy Winehouse
milestone: Released debut album Frank in October 2003 at age 20, which was commercially successful in the UK and earned an Ivor Novello Award for its lead single 'Stronger Than Me' in 2004.

name: Simone Inzaghi
milestone: Scored 15 goals in 30 Serie A matches for Piacenza in the 1998-99 season at age 22, earning a transfer to Lazio where he won the Serie A title, Coppa Italia, and UEFA Super Cup by age 24.

name: Gary Moore
milestone: Released debut album 'Skid' with Skid Row on CBS in October 1970 at age 18, reaching #30 on the UK album chart, and released a second album '34 Hours' in 1971 before joining Thin Lizzy in 1974.

name: Antonio Conte
milestone: Made his Serie A debut for Lecce at age 16 in April 1986, joined Juventus in 1991 at age 22, and won the UEFA Cup (1993), Serie A title (1995), and Coppa Italia (1995) with Juventus — multiple major trophies before age 26.

name: Daniel Passarella
milestone: Joined River Plate, one of Argentina's biggest clubs, in 1973 at age 20; debuted for Argentina national team in March 1976 at age 22; named Argentine Footballer of the Year in 1976; won multiple league titles (1975 Metropolitano, 1975 Nacional) by age 22.

name: Joe Hisaishi
milestone: Composed music for broadcast anime series 'Hajime Ningen Gyatoruzu' (1974) at age 23-24 and 'Robokko Beeton' (1976) at age 25-26, and presented his first public performance around 1975, establishing a professional composing career by age 26.

name: Axl Rose
milestone: Co-founded Guns N' Roses in 1985 (age 22-23), released the debut album 'Appetite for Destruction' in July 1987 (age 25), which reached #1 on the Billboard 200 in August 1988 (age 26) and became the best-selling debut album in US history with over 30 million copies sold worldwide.

name: Gwyneth Paltrow
milestone: At age 26, Paltrow won the Academy Award for Best Actress for 'Shakespeare in Love' (1998) at the 71st Academy Awards ceremony on March 21, 1999. The film was released in December 1998 when she was 26, and she had already gained notice for roles in 'Seven' (1995) and 'Emma' (1996).

name: Robert Smith
milestone: As frontman and principal songwriter of The Cure, released debut album 'Three Imaginary Boys' in May 1979 (age 20), followed by four more studio albums by age 26, establishing The Cure as an internationally successful and influential post-punk/alternative rock band.

name: Nicki Minaj
milestone: Released two mixtapes by 2008 (age 25-26), with 'Sucka Free' charting on Billboard's Top R&B/Hip-Hop Albums and winning Female Artist of the Year at the 2008 Underground Music Awards.

name: Tostão
milestone: Won the 1970 FIFA World Cup with Brazil at age 23, and had already won the Taça Brasil with Cruzeiro at age 19 (1966), scoring against Pelé's Santos in the final.

name: Jay-Z
milestone: Co-founded Roc-A-Fella Records in 1995 (age 25-26) and released debut album 'Reasonable Doubt' on June 25, 1996 (age 26), which peaked at #23 on the Billboard 200.

name: Adele
milestone: Released debut album '19' in January 2008 at age 19, which became one of the best-selling debut albums in UK history with top-five singles 'Chasing Pavements' and 'Make You Feel My Love'; won Grammy for Best New Artist at age 20.

name: Paulo Roberto Falcão
milestone: Won the Brazilian Série A national championship with Internacional in 1975 at age 22, followed by repeat titles in 1976 and 1979, all by age 26.

name: Jeff Bezos
milestone: Became the youngest senior vice president at D.E. Shaw & Co., a prominent Wall Street investment firm, in 1990 at age 26.

name: Jürgen Klinsmann
milestone: Became a regular starter in the Bundesliga (top German division) at VfB Stuttgart from 1984 at age 20, scoring 15 goals in his first Bundesliga season, and was a prolific scorer through age 26, culminating in winning the 1990 FIFA World Cup with West Germany.

name: Kanye West
milestone: Produced multiple tracks on Jay-Z's landmark album The Blueprint (2001) at age 24, becoming one of hip-hop's most sought-after producers; signed solo deal with Roc-A-Fella Records in 2002 and released debut album The College Dropout in February 2004 at age 26.

name: Dave Murray
milestone: As a founding member of Iron Maiden, played on the band's self-titled debut album (1980, UK #4) and follow-up Killers (1981) by age 24, with The Number of the Beast (1982) following by age 25.

name: Steve Ballmer
milestone: Joined Microsoft in June 1980 at age 24 as its 30th employee and first business manager, receiving $50,000 salary and 7% equity; by late 1981 (age 25) he helped secure the landmark IBM deal to outfit all new PCs with MS-DOS, one of the most consequential deals in tech history.

name: Bryan Adams
milestone: Released his debut album on A&M Records at age 20 (1980), and by 25 his album 'Reckless' (1984) reached #1 in the US and Canada, became the first Canadian album certified diamond, and produced multiple top-ten hits including the US #1 single 'Heaven'.

name: Rihanna
milestone: Her debut single 'Pon de Replay' reached #2 on the Billboard Hot 100 in 2005 at age 17, and her debut album 'Music of the Sun' was released the same year on Def Jam Recordings.

name: Andy Cole
milestone: In the 1993-94 season at age 22-23, Cole was the Premier League top scorer with 34 league goals (41 in all competitions) for Newcastle United, won the PFA Young Player of the Year award, and set a club record for goals in a season that still stands.

name: Glenn Hughes
milestone: By age 22 (1973), Hughes joined Deep Purple — then one of the world's biggest rock bands — as bassist and co-lead vocalist, and by age 26 (1977) he had recorded three albums with them including the classic 'Burn' (1974), 'Stormbringer' (1974), and 'Come Taste the Band' (1975).

name: Kaká
milestone: At age 20 (2002), Kaká won the FIFA World Cup with Brazil. At age 25 (2007), he won the UEFA Champions League with AC Milan as the tournament's top scorer, and won the Ballon d'Or and FIFA World Player of the Year — the highest individual honors in football.

name: Bebeto
milestone: Won the 1983 FIFA U-20 World Cup with Brazil at age 19 and became a prolific striker for Flamengo (144 goals in 286 appearances), earning his first senior Brazil cap at 21 and an Olympic silver medal at 24.

name: Bobby Farrell
milestone: Was a member of Boney M. when their single 'Daddy Cool' was released on May 31, 1976 and became a European hit after a September 1976 TV appearance, when Farrell was 26 years old.

name: Marie Fredriksson
milestone: Released her debut solo album 'Het vind' on EMI Sweden in September 1984 at age 26, which peaked at number 20 on the Swedish album chart, preceded by the top-20 single 'Ännu doftar kärlek' in May 1984.

name: Mohamed Salah
milestone: At age 25, scored 32 Premier League goals in the 2017-18 season (a record for a 38-game season), won PFA Player of the Year, and led Liverpool to the Champions League final.

name: Andrew Wiles
milestone: Co-authored with John Coates the paper 'On the Conjecture of Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer' (Inventiones Mathematicae, 1977) at age 24, making the first progress on one of mathematics' fundamental conjectures, and became Assistant Professor at Harvard University the same year.

name: Andrés Escobar
milestone: By age 22, Escobar had debuted for Atlético Nacional's senior team (1986, age 19), helped the club win the 1989 Copa Libertadores—the most prestigious club tournament in South American football—and the 1989 Copa Interamericana, and played at the 1990 FIFA World Cup for Colombia.

name: Gene Simmons
milestone: Co-founded the rock band KISS in January 1973 at age 23, releasing three studio albums by age 26 including the debut 'Kiss' (Feb 1974) and 'Dressed to Kill' (Mar 1975).

name: Anna Netrebko
milestone: Won the Mikhail Glinka vocal competition in 1993 at age 22 and made her operatic stage debut at the Mariinsky Theatre in 1994 at age 22 as Susanna in The Marriage of Figaro, followed by her US debut at San Francisco Opera in 1995 and entry into the Merola Opera Program in 1996.

name: Evan Williams
milestone: Co-founded Pyra Labs on January 1, 1999 at age 26, which created Blogger, one of the first and most influential blog-publishing platforms.

name: Noah Glass
milestone: Co-founded Twitter in 2006 at age 24-25 within Odeo; coined the name 'Twitter' and helped design core features before being ousted later that year.

name: Pierre Omidyar
milestone: Co-founded Ink Development Corp (later eShop Inc.) on May 10, 1991 at age 23, an early pioneer of online shopping software later acquired by Microsoft in 1996.

name: Dries Buytaert
milestone: Released Drupal 1.0.0 as open-source software on January 15, 2001, at age 22; Drupal went on to become one of the world's most widely used content management systems, powering approximately 1 in 35 websites globally.

name: Rasmus Lerdorf
milestone: Released PHP 1.0 (Personal Home Page Tools) on June 8, 1995, at age 26, posting the announcement to the comp.infosystems.www.authoring.cgi Usenet newsgroup; PHP went on to become the most widely used server-side web programming language, powering over 76% of websites with a known server-side language.

name: James Gosling
milestone: Wrote Gosling Emacs in 1981 at age 25, the first Emacs implementation for Unix, written in C and commercially distributed by UniPress Software.

name: Anders Hejlsberg
milestone: Turbo Pascal 1.0 was released by Borland in November 1983, based on Hejlsberg's PolyPascal compiler which he wrote starting at age 19-20; it became one of the most commercially successful Pascal compilers of all time.

name: Rob Pike
milestone: Wrote the first bitmap window system for Unix in 1981 at age 25 at Bell Labs, and designed the Blit programmable bitmap graphics terminal with Bart Locanthi in 1982, which was commercialized by AT&T as the DMD 5620.

name: Adi Shamir
milestone: Co-invented the RSA public-key cryptosystem with Ron Rivest and Len Adleman at MIT in 1977, with the seminal paper published in Communications of the ACM in February 1978 at age 25.

name: Ralph Merkle
milestone: Devised Merkle's Puzzles, an early public-key cryptographic key exchange scheme, as an undergraduate at UC Berkeley in 1974, and submitted the paper to Communications of the ACM in August 1975.

name: Shafi Goldwasser
milestone: Co-authored the seminal Goldwasser-Micali paper on probabilistic encryption at STOC 1982, introducing semantic security and probabilistic encryption as foundational concepts in modern cryptography.

name: Andy Bechtolsheim
milestone: Designed and built the first SUN workstation at Stanford University, with a working prototype by November 30, 1980 at age 25; co-founded Sun Microsystems in February 1982 at age 26.

name: Vinod Khosla
milestone: Co-founded Daisy Systems, a pioneering electronic design automation company, in January 1981 at age 25-26, serving as its first full-time founder and CFO.

name: Bill Joy
milestone: Principal author of BSD UNIX (1BSD released March 1978) and creator of the vi text editor and C shell, establishing him as a legendary figure in computing by his early twenties.

name: Robert Tappan Morris
milestone: Created and released the Morris worm on November 2, 1988, the first Internet worm, which infected approximately 10% of internet-connected computers and became a landmark event in computer security history.

name: Chris Wanstrath
milestone: Co-founded GitHub and publicly launched it in April 2008 at age 23; the platform reached 100,000 users by July 2009 and became the world's largest code host.

name: PJ Hyett
milestone: Co-founded GitHub and publicly launched it in April 2008 at age 24; the platform reached 100,000 users by July 2009 and became the world's largest code host.

name: Blake Ross
milestone: Co-created the Firefox web browser (originally Phoenix) with Dave Hyatt, first released in September 2002 at age 17; Firefox 1.0 launched November 9, 2004 at age 19 and was downloaded 27 million+ times, challenging Internet Explorer's dominance.

name: James Clark
milestone: Released groff 0.3.1 in June 1990, the first version of his from-scratch GNU implementation of the Unix troff typesetting system, which became a standard part of Linux.

name: Adam Curry
milestone: Became a VJ for MTV in 1987 at age 23, hosting Headbangers Ball and MTV Top 20 Video Countdown, interviewing stars like Michael Jackson and Paul McCartney.

name: Ben Goodger
milestone: Served as lead engineer for Firefox 1.0, released in November 2004 at age 24, which challenged Microsoft's Internet Explorer dominance and grew to tens of millions of users.

name: Marissa Mayer
milestone: Joined Google in 1999 as employee #20 and its first woman software engineer at age 24, developing and designing Google's search offerings during the company's critical early growth period.

name: Eric Schmidt
milestone: Co-authored Lex, the standard Unix lexical analyzer generator, with Mike Lesk at Bell Labs in 1975 at age 20; Lex became a fundamental tool in compiler construction and remains widely used.

name: Yann LeCun
milestone: Proposed and published an early version of the error backpropagation algorithm at the COGNITIVA conference in Paris in June 1985, at age 24, a foundational contribution to neural network learning.

name: Wojciech Zaremba
milestone: Co-authored 'Intriguing properties of neural networks' (arXiv Dec 2013, ICLR 2014), a foundational paper on adversarial examples in neural networks with 19,000+ citations, while a PhD student at NYU.

name: Greg Brockman
milestone: Became the first CTO of Stripe in 2013, helping scale the company from 5 to over 200 employees.

name: Demis Hassabis
milestone: Co-designed and lead-programmed the 1994 game Theme Park at Bullfrog Productions at age 17, which sold several million copies and won a Golden Joystick award.

name: Mustafa Suleyman
milestone: Co-founded DeepMind Technologies in September 2010 at age 26, which was acquired by Google for £400 million in 2014.

name: David Silver
milestone: Co-founded Elixir Studios in 1998 as CTO and lead programmer, securing a three-game publishing deal with Eidos Interactive.

name: Ken Howery
milestone: Co-founded PayPal (originally Confinity) in 1998 at age 23, serving as the company's first CFO and helping raise over $200 million in private financing.

name: Luke Nosek
milestone: Co-founded PayPal (originally Confinity) in 1998 at age 23, serving as VP of Marketing and Strategy and creating the company's 'Instant Transfer' product, its most profitable offering.

name: Rob Kalin
milestone: Co-founded Etsy in June 2005 at age 25, launching an online marketplace for handmade goods that grew into a multi-billion-dollar public company.

name: Haim Schoppik
milestone: Co-founded Etsy in June 2005 at age 25 and served as its first CTO, building the initial platform's technical infrastructure.

name: Jack Abraham
milestone: Founded Milo.com in 2008 at age 22, a local product search engine that was acquired by eBay in December 2010 for approximately $75 million when he was 24.

name: Travis Kalanick
milestone: Joined the Scour founding team in mid-1998 at age 22 and dropped out of UCLA to work full-time; Scour raised investment from former Disney president Michael Ovitz and became a high-profile P2P file-sharing company before facing a $250 billion lawsuit.

name: Brian Armstrong
milestone: Founded UniversityTutor.com in 2003 at age 20 while studying at Rice University, building and running an online tutor-matching platform that grew to over 129,000 tutors across 125 countries and was eventually acquired in 2012.

name: Fred Ehrsam
milestone: Co-founded Coinbase in 2012 at age 24 with Brian Armstrong, building what became the largest U.S. cryptocurrency exchange; served as its first President.

name: Jed McCaleb
milestone: Founded MetaMachine and released eDonkey2000 on September 6, 2000 at age 25, creating one of the world's most popular peer-to-peer file-sharing networks which grew to over 3-4 million concurrent users at its peak.

name: Wei Dai
milestone: Released Crypto++ 1.0 in June 1995 at age 23-24, a free open-source C++ cryptographic library that became widely used in academia and industry.

name: Adam Back
milestone: Invented Hashcash, a proof-of-work system for combating email spam, posting it to the Cypherpunks mailing list in March 1997 at age 26; Hashcash's proof-of-work mechanism was later adopted in Bitcoin mining.

name: Roger Ver
milestone: Founded MemoryDealers.com in 1999 at age 19-20, an online business selling networking equipment that grew to become a market leader generating millions of dollars in revenue and employing dozens of people worldwide.

name: Winklevoss Twins
milestone: Won gold medal in the eights rowing event and silver in the coxless four at the 2007 Pan American Games in Rio de Janeiro at age 25.

name: Tyler Winklevoss
milestone: Won gold medal in the eights rowing event and silver in the coxless four at the 2007 Pan American Games in Rio de Janeiro at age 25.

name: Cameron Winklevoss
milestone: Won gold medal in the eights rowing event and silver in the coxless four at the 2007 Pan American Games in Rio de Janeiro at age 25.

name: Michael Saylor
milestone: Founded MicroStrategy in 1989 at age 24, a business intelligence software company that went public in 1998 and at its peak made Saylor a multibillionaire.

name: Dharmesh Shah
milestone: Founded Pyramid Digital Solutions in April 1994 at age 26, an enterprise software company in the financial services sector that became a three-time Inc. 500 recipient and was acquired by SunGard in 2005 for its $15M+ annual revenue business.

name: Neil Patel
milestone: Co-founded Crazy Egg in 2005 at age 20, a widely used web analytics heatmap tool, and co-founded KISSmetrics in 2008 at age 23, a person-based analytics platform that raised $4M+ in venture capital.

name: Hiten Shah
milestone: Co-founded Advantage Consulting Services (ACS) in 2002 at age 23, an online marketing firm serving Fortune 500 clients including HP, Samsung, GM, and Amazon, and co-founded Crazy Egg in 2005 at age 26.

name: Sujan Patel
milestone: Built Single Grain, a digital marketing agency founded around 2005, to over $2M in annual revenue with 23 employees and 45 clients by 2011 at age 26, serving clients like Warby Parker, LinkedIn, and Sony.

name: Andrew Mason
milestone: Founded The Point in November 2007 at age 26 with $1 million in seed funding from Eric Lefkofsky, a social initiatives platform that was later pivoted into Groupon, one of the fastest-growing companies in history.

name: Eric Lefkofsky
milestone: Co-founded Brandon Apparel Group in 1993 at age 24 with Brad Keywell, borrowing money from relatives to acquire the company and growing it from $2M to $20M in annual sales by the late 1990s.

name: Brad Keywell
milestone: Co-founded Brandon Apparel Group in 1993 at age 24 with Eric Lefkofsky, borrowing money from relatives to acquire the company and growing it from $2M to $20M in annual sales by the late 1990s.

name: Jason Calacanis
milestone: Founded Silicon Alley Reporter in 1996 at age 26, a newsletter covering New York's tech scene that grew into a 300-page glossy magazine generating millions in ad revenue, making him a central figure in the Silicon Alley community.

name: Jason Fried
milestone: Co-founded 37signals in 1999 at age 25, a web design company that became an influential software firm, launching Basecamp in 2004 which grew to millions of users and over $100M in annual revenue.

name: Robert Reffkin
milestone: Selected as a White House Fellow in 2005 at age 26, one of approximately 15-20 fellows chosen annually from thousands of applicants, working directly for the Secretary of the Treasury John W. Snow; previously graduated from Columbia University in under two years and was the youngest analyst hired by McKinsey & Company.

name: Oren Alexander
milestone: Named to Forbes 30 Under 30 list for real estate in 2011 at age 24, and sold the most expensive home in Miami (a $47M estate in Indian Creek) at age 25 in 2012, establishing himself as one of the top luxury real estate brokers in the country.

name: Stéphane Lambiel
milestone: Won his first World Figure Skating Championship title in 2005 at age 20, becoming the first Swiss man to win Worlds in 48 years, and repeated as World champion in 2006.

name: Joe Sakic
milestone: Named Canadian Hockey League Player of the Year in 1988 at age 18 after scoring 160 points in the WHL, and made his NHL debut in 1988 at age 19, scoring 102 points in his second NHL season (1989-90) at age 20.

name: Johnny Rep
milestone: Won the European Cup (Champions League) with Ajax in 1972 and 1973, scoring the winning goal in the 1973 final against Juventus at age 21, and reached the FIFA World Cup final with the Netherlands in 1974 at age 22.

name: Marina Lobatch
milestone: Won the USSR Cup in rhythmic gymnastics in 1985 at age 15, earned a silver medal at the 1985 World Championships at age 15, won World Championship gold in hoop in 1987 at age 17, and won Olympic gold at the 1988 Seoul Olympics at age 18 with a perfect score of 60.000.

name: Kumar Sangakkara
milestone: Made ODI and Test debut for Sri Lanka in July 2000 at age 22, scoring 98 on Test debut against South Africa, and was part of the Sri Lanka squad that won the 2002 ICC Champions Trophy at age 24.

name: Pietro Mennea
milestone: Won Olympic bronze medal in the 200m at the 1972 Munich Olympics at age 20, and became European champion in the 200m in 1974 at age 22.

name: John Galliano
milestone: Graduated from Central Saint Martins in 1984 with a first-class honours degree; his graduating collection 'Les Incroyables' was bought in its entirety by the London boutique Browns, launching his career at age 23. Named British Fashion Designer of the Year in 1987 at age 26.

name: Harald Schumacher
milestone: Made Bundesliga debut with 1. FC Köln in the 1973-74 season at age 19-20, won the DFB-Pokal in 1977 at age 23, and won the Bundesliga and DFB-Pokal double in 1978 at age 24, establishing himself as one of Germany's top goalkeepers before 26.

name: Moana Pozzi
milestone: Performed in her first hardcore film 'Valentina, ragazza in calore' in 1981 at age 20 under the pseudonym Linda Heveret, and co-hosted the children's television program 'Tip Tap Club' on Rete 2 in 1982 at age 21 before being suspended when her adult film career was discovered, creating a national scandal.

name: Kim Clijsters
milestone: Won her first WTA singles title at the Luxembourg Open in September 1999 at age 16, also reaching the Wimbledon fourth round and earning WTA Newcomer of the Year the same year.

name: Avi Loeb
milestone: Earned a PhD in plasma physics at age 24 (1986) and led the first international project funded by the U.S. Strategic Defense Initiative from 1983 to 1988, before joining the Institute for Advanced Study at Princeton in 1988.

name: Tamara Rojo
milestone: Won a gold medal and Special Jury Award at the Paris International Dance Competition in 1994 at age 20, judged by a panel including Natalia Makarova and Vladimir Vasiliev.

name: Levon Aronian
milestone: Earned the title of chess grandmaster in 2000 at age 17, after winning the World Youth Chess Championship (Under-12) in 1994 and later winning the World Junior Championship in 2002 at age 20.

name: Fan Zhendong
milestone: Won the 2012 World Junior Table Tennis Championships singles title at age 15 and became the youngest ever ITTF World Tour winner at 16 in 2013, before winning the World Team Championships gold and Men's World Cup by age 19.

name: Sergei Polunin
milestone: Became the Royal Ballet's youngest ever male principal dancer in June 2010 at age 20, after winning the Prix de Lausanne in 2006 at 17 and being named Young British Dancer of the Year in 2007.

name: Qasem Soleimani
milestone: Commanded the 41st Tharallah unit (initially a battalion, later expanded to brigade and division) of the IRGC during the Iran-Iraq War from 1980 at age 23, leading troops in combat across multiple fronts.

name: Rebeca Andrade
milestone: Won Olympic gold medal in vault and silver in all-around at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics (held 2021), becoming the first Brazilian female gymnast to win an Olympic medal.

name: Tan Dun
milestone: His string quartet 'Feng Ya Song' (1982) won second prize at the 1983 Dresden International Weber Chamber Music Competition (age 26), making him the first Chinese-trained composer to win a prize at an international competition for contemporary works.

name: Kevin Keegan
milestone: Won the First Division title and UEFA Cup with Liverpool in the 1972-73 season at age 22, establishing himself as one of England's top forwards.

name: Yoel Romero
milestone: Won the 1999 World Wrestling Championships gold medal at 85 kg freestyle at age 22, followed by Olympic silver at the 2000 Sydney Games at age 23.

name: Annie Lennox
milestone: As vocalist of The Tourists, reached #4 on the UK Singles Chart with 'I Only Want to Be with You' in November 1979 at age 24, followed by a second top-10 hit in early 1980.

name: Marco Pantani
milestone: Finished second overall at the 1994 Giro d'Italia with two stage wins, and placed third overall at the 1994 Tour de France, both at age 24.

name: Krisztina Egerszegi
milestone: Won Olympic gold in the 200m backstroke at the 1988 Seoul Olympics at age 14, becoming the youngest-ever female Olympic swimming champion, and added a silver in the 100m backstroke.

name: Wladimir Resnitschenko
milestone: Won team épée gold at the 1987 World Championships representing the Soviet Union at age 22, followed by Olympic team épée bronze at the 1988 Seoul Olympics at age 23.

name: Johan Museeuw
milestone: Won two prestigious stages at the 1990 Tour de France at age 24, including the uphill-sprint stage to Mont Saint-Michel and the final stage on the Champs-Élysées in Paris.

name: Björk
milestone: Released debut album 'Life's Too Good' with the Sugarcubes in April 1988 at age 22, achieving international chart success and critical acclaim as the band's lead singer.

name: Anna Muzychuk
milestone: Awarded the FIDE Grandmaster title in 2012 at age 21, becoming the fourth woman in chess history to reach a 2600 Elo rating, and won the Women's World Blitz Chess Championship in 2014 at age 24.

name: Cecilia Bolocco
milestone: Won Miss Universe 1987 on May 26, 1987 in Singapore, becoming the first Chilean to win the title.

name: Lasse Kjus
milestone: Won gold in the combined event at the 1993 FIS World Championships in Morioka, Japan, marking his senior-level international breakthrough.

name: Dayana Mendoza
milestone: Won Miss Universe 2008 on July 13, 2008 in Nha Trang, Vietnam, at age 22, becoming the first Venezuelan Miss Universe since 1996.
